body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success, deal 1 Fire damage. If it is already Burning, deal +1 damage.

surges.html: On a success, you may replace Burning on the target with Chilled or Corroded after this Action resolves.
Create a small persistent magical object or patch of terrain appropriate to this spell until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: FIRE THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread when a future Magecraft Action applies a damage Condition to extend that Condition through the end of the target's next turn.
